## `neuro.array.toReversed`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`.

> Returns a copy of an array with its elements reversed.

## Signatures

```ts
toReversed(input: { array: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<T[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.toReversed` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
